- UK Trade Jobs had the noisiest subagent output, so I checked it live. As of 22:02 BST, `https://uktradejobs.com/api/jobs/reed?mode=default&page=0` is returning `pageSize=150` with 150 results. So the true live default is now 150, not 100. `uktradejobs.com` is up.

3. Blue Canvas lead-capture sprint

4. UKTJ monetisation…
